question: How much international bandwidth does Airtel's 2Africa Pearls 2025 undersea cable landing system add?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Over 100 terabits per second**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Airtel 2Africa Pearls undersea cable system is a significant addition to India's international bandwidth infrastructure.
 
• It provides over **100 terabits per second** of international bandwidth capacity, enabling faster and more reliable internet connectivity.
 
• This cable system is part of the 2Africa initiative</strong
